rule_text;: grant create on nodes (u:User) to guest;
grant add{name} on nodes (u:User) where u.role = "member" to guest;
grant traverse on nodes (u:User) where u.active = true to guest;
grant read{email} on nodes (u:User) to guest;
grant create on nodes (p:Post) to author;
grant traverse on nodes (p:Post) to author;
grant add{content} on nodes (p:Post) where p.status = "draft" to author;
grant read{content} on nodes (p:Post) to author;
grant create on nodes (c:Comment) to member;
grant traverse on nodes (c:Comment) where c.approved = true to member;
grant add{text} on nodes (c:Comment) where c.flagged = false to member;
grant add{likes} on nodes (c:Comment) where c.flagged = false to member;
grant read{text} on nodes (c:Comment) to member;
grant create on relationships (r:REPLIED_TO) to member;
grant add{timestamp} on relationships (r:REPLIED_TO) where r.length < 5 to member;
grant read{timestamp} on relationships (r:REPLIED_TO) to member;
deny read{date} on nodes (x:Archive) to Admin;
grant add{*} on nodes (x:Archive) to Admin;
grant read{*} on nodes (x:Archive) to Admin;
deny traverse on nodes (c:Comment) to member;
deny traverse on nodes (c:Tweet) to member;
grant create on nodes (*) to member;
grant create on nodes (*) to CEO;
grant add{*} on nodes (t:Tweet) to Admin;
grant read{posted_at} on nodes (t:Tweet) to Admin;
